Per the rules I did not guess URLs, search through other services or add venues from memory. Work was limited to opening the websites already recorded in the seed for this region (16 seed entries across Kilifi, Kwale, Lamu, Taita-Taveta and Watamu, plus Voi's OSM-only 'Unique Sports Gym and Fitness'). Results: Combat Kenya (Voi) gained phone numbers and an address; Banana House (Lamu) confirmed active in 2026. Three seed websites (Bold Gym International, Step 'n' Step Gym, Eagle Camp Mida Creek) do not resolve from this environment; Beach Life Fitness returned only a page title. No seed website exists for Rox Park Gym Diani True Fitness, Diani Swimming and Fitness, Uzuri Spa Fitness Forest, Moto fitness studio, Happy's Animation and gym, Mariakani Gym or Unique Sports Gym and Fitness, so those could not be enriched without search. Zero new (non-seed) venues found; absence here means 'not searched', not 'no gyms exist'.
